verses.1: Unto the end. A Psalm of David.
verses.2: Rescue me, O Lord, from the evil man. Rescue me from the iniquitous leader.
verses.3: Those who have devised iniquities in their hearts: all day long they constructed conflicts.
verses.4: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. The venom of asps is under their lips.
verses.5: Preserve me, O Lord, from the hand of the sinner, and rescue me from men of iniquity. They have decided to supplant my steps.
verses.6: The arrogant have hidden a snare for me. And they have stretched out cords for a snare. They have placed a stumbling block for me near the road.
verses.7: I said to the Lord: You are my God. O Lord, heed the voice of my supplication.
verses.8: Lord, O Lord, the strength of my salvation: you have overshadowed my head in the day of war.
verses.9: O Lord, do not hand me over to the sinner by my desire. They have plotted against me. Do not abandon me, lest they should triumph.
verses.10: The head of those who encompass me, the labor of their lips, will overwhelm them.
verses.11: Burning coals will fall upon them. You will cast them down into the fire, into miseries that they will not be able to withstand.
verses.12: A talkative man will not be guided aright upon the earth. Evils will drag the unjust man unto utter ruin.
verses.13: I know that the Lord will accomplish justice for the needy and vindication for the poor.
verses.14: So then, truly, the just will confess your name, and the upright will dwell with your countenance. [ Psalm 140 ] (141)
